doc.title: Jack DeJohnette interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 7, 2025

title: Howard Johnson and Monk's Mood on Album Album
summary: He praises Howard Johnson's multi-instrument talent and arrangement of Monk's Mood.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Um hum. I’ll run a few names by you and just wonder if you have a comment or association that you might share with me. One would be Howard Johnson.

Yeah well Howard was a unique musician in the sense that he played tuba and saxophone and played trumpet. And he was a good composer/arranger. And he arranged a beautiful version of “Monk’s Mood” on the “Album Album.” At the time I was using an electric melodica so I could add another voice to the arrangement. It was really great. A very talented guy.
